from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """Metrics extracted from one university's Common Data Set report."""
    university: str | None = Field(description="The university or college name")
    total_bachelor_degrees: int | None = Field(description="Total bachelor's degrees awarded in the reporting period")
    social_sciences_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of bachelor's degrees in Social Sciences")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2020-2021' or date range")
    degrees_section: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section reporting degree count, e.g., 'B3'")
    percent_section: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section reporting discipline breakdown, e.g., 'J1', 'J'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_metrics: list[UniversityMetric]
